attackAtlas.layout: col0=front attack swipe, col1=side attack swipe

source: User-provided Lag Sprite sheet (JPG with checkerboard background removed via border flood-fill)
notes: Background removed via flood-fill from image border through grayscale pixels only; eyes/highlights inside the body were preserved.
Single shared scale factor computed from the largest raw frame bounding box; all frames share this scale (no per-frame distortion).
Opaque foot baseline aligned to y=58 in every 64x64 cell, matching the Oracle anchor convention (x=.5, y=58/64).
Column 6 in both rows is a distinct attack-swipe pose, split into its own attack atlas rather than mixed into the walk/idle loop.
In-game animation smoothness and side-view facing direction need visual QA; not verified from metadata alone.
